analysis: You started this stretch a little rough — under 6 hours on 14 July — but then you bounced back with a 9h 22m night that honestly felt like your body just going "okay, we're doing this now," and the middle of the week held really solid with three nights all clearing 7 hours and that beautiful 53-minute deep sleep on the 17th. The back end is where things got scrappy again: last two nights you're losing ground to wakefulness, with 51 minutes and then a chunky 1h 22m awake on the 20th, which is your body telling you something's disrupting the landing even when the wind-down stack is doing its thing. Your REM is mostly holding (that 2h 12m on the 15th is genuinely lovely), so the architecture is there — it's just those late-night wake windows that are stealing the shine.
